snippet.title: Mining Company (Steam Release Trailer)
snippet.description:
Mining Company now available on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433640/Mining_Company/


OBJECTIVES

You've got a new company and have taken out a loan on a spaceship. To make money, you fly to nearby asteroids and mine through caves to collect and sell gems so you make the payments in time. The cash you earn can be used to travel to new asteroids with higher risks and rewards--or you can buy upgrades to your tools and your spaceship. Explore the asteroids, watching for all sorts of enemies along the way, especially those that come out at night.

DON'T GO BY YOURSELF

The monsters and robots on the asteroids prey on the vulnerable and singled-out, so the help of your friends is invaluable. Coordinate your mining and survival plans easily with in-game proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies.

TRADE THE MARKET

The minerals market updates every second, so always keep one eye on the gem prices. After all, the only thing more frightening than the vast emptiness of space is an empty wallet. Selling the right gems, at the right moment, on the right asteroid boom market, can make your expedition and failing to do so can send it into ruin... financial or otherwise. The store has many goods for delivery, including torches, pickaxe upgrades, fuel expansion tanks, exosuit movement upgrades, and stamina upgrades.

MOVE QUICKLY

The day on the asteroid goes fast. Communicate with your crew to get back to the ship and out of the mines, and have fuel ready for take off. Don't let the nighttime monsters sneak aboard your ship! How long can your crew survive?
